A pattern of sexual attraction — a VALUE pointed at by [`gmeow:sexualOrientationValue`](../properties/gmeow-sexualOrientationValue.md), never a subclass. Open: an orientation not seeded here is a fresh individual with [rdfs:label.](http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#label.)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:SexualOrientationValue`](gmeow-SexualOrientationValue.md) as a specialized kind of [`gufo:QualityValue`](../../external/terms.md#gufo-qualityvalue). Add statement metadata or a standpoint when the assertion needs provenance, confidence, or vantage.

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use as the open value vocabulary for sexual-attraction patterns — reference a seed (heterosexual, homosexual, bisexual, pansexual, asexual, demisexual, queer, questioning) or mint a fresh individual for the long tail, each lossily aligned to GSSO/Homosaurus/Wikidata.

### Avoid when

- Avoid minting per-value subclasses or forcing the set into a closed enum (it is an open individual vocabulary), and avoid co-typing a sexual value as a romantic one — the two value spaces are kept disjoint under split-attraction.

### How to use

- Reference a seeded individual from [`gmeow:sexualOrientationValue`](../properties/gmeow-sexualOrientationValue.md), or mint a fresh [`gmeow:SexualOrientationValue`](gmeow-SexualOrientationValue.md) with an [rdfs:label](http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#label) and an SSSOM alignment row when the orientation is not seeded; never promote a value to a subclass.

### Examples

- [`gmeow:orientPansexual`](../individuals/gmeow-orientPansexual.md) a [`gmeow:SexualOrientationValue`](gmeow-SexualOrientationValue.md); [rdfs:label](http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#label) "pansexual"@en.
